0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_Q1_000_000
0.description: What would you like to do?

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_A1_000_020
2.description: Remove infusion from a sphere scroll.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_000
6.description: Using the superior enchanted ink you bring, I shall prepare a sphere scroll bearing arcanima patterns for enhancing your relic.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_Q2_000_000
7.description: Select the sphere scroll you would like created.<hex:02100103>※Three bottles of ink required for each, with the<hex:02100103>exception of Curtana (2) and the Holy Shield (1).

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_040
14.description: By virtue of rote, in the blinking of an eye...your sphere scroll is ready! You are at liberty to infuse it with the materia of your choosing! Assuming it's compatible, that is...

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_050
15.description: You have obtained a sphere scroll. To infuse it with materia, access it in your inventory, then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Infuse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the subcommands.

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_051
16.description: Once you have fully infused a sphere scroll with materia, you may present it to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Jalzahn<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to have the corresponding relic weapon enhanced.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_080
17.description: Oh dear, 'twould seem you do not have enough bottles of ink. Let us speak again when you have procured the requisite amount.

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_090
18.description: Three bottles of superior enchanted ink are required to create a sphere scroll for each relic, with the exception of Curtana (2) and the Holy Shield (1).

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_100
19.description: ...Hm? You do not appear to have that relic on hand. Without a visual reference, I'm afraid I cannot draw the proper arcanima patterns.

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_110
20.description: In order to obtain a sphere scroll, the associated relic weapon animus must be in your possession.

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_111
21.description: Relic weapons that have been upgraded beyond animus are also acceptable for this purpose.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_120
22.description: ...Hm? 'Twould seem you already possess that particular sphere scroll. Surely, you do not wish to waste good ink?

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_125
23.description: Oh dear, 'twould seem your hands are full. Let us speak again after you have tidied up your belongings.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_130
24.description: You wish to remove some of the infusion from your sphere scroll? Very well.

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_Q4_000_000
25.description: Select a sphere scroll for infusion removal.

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_Q5_000_000
27.description: Select an attribute for single infusion removal.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_Q6SYSETM_000_000
30.description: Remove a single infusion for the following attribute?<hex:02100103><hex:02280FFF0A42617365506172616DE8020203> (Infused: <hex:022003E80303>)

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_400
33.description: ...The deed is done. May you find the ideal balance of power that you seek.

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_500
35.description: ...Hm? 'Twould seem you do not possess that particular sphere scroll.

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_520
36.description: ...Hm? 'Twould seem that this sphere scroll has yet to receive any infusions.

37.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_600
37.description: A sphere scroll is a medium for storing materia-derived light energy. It bears arcanima patterns of power, into which the energy is infused for collective transference to a vessel of one's choosing.

38.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_601
38.description: Instrumental to this infusion process is a catalyst known as alexandrite, a rare variety of dark matter. Through this method, I seek to circumvent the constraints of advanced materia melding, wherein an object can safely host only a limited number of stones.

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_602
39.description: If you bring me bottles of superior enchanted ink, I should be glad to prepare a sphere scroll bearing arcanima patterns for enhancing your relic.

40.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_610
40.description: Sphere scrolls may be obtained from Hubairtin in exchange for bottles of superior enchanted ink.

41.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_611
41.description: A distinct sphere scroll exists for each relic.

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_100_611
42.description: Three bottles of ink are required to create each scroll, with the exception of Curtana (2) and the Holy Shield (1).

43.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_612
43.description: Each sphere scroll can be infused with up to five types of materia. Please note, however, that certain restrictions apply to quantity and variety.

44.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_100_612
44.description: Furthermore, due to the unstable nature of materia-derived light energy, infusion attempts are known to fail on occasion.

45.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_613
45.description: Once you have fully infused a sphere scroll with materia, present it to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Jalzahn<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> at Hyrstmill in the North Shroud to have the corresponding relic weapon enhanced.

46.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_700
46.description: Alexandrite is the catalyst by which the power of materia may be converted into light and infused into a sphere scroll.

47.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_701
47.description: Being a variety of dark matter, the stone possesses light-altering properties. When placed beneath a light source, it bursts into a dazzling display of colors.

48.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_702
48.description: Owing to its singular beauty, alexandrite was highly prized by ancient civilizations, and so nigh every natural deposit has been exhausted.

49.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_HUBAIRTIN_000_703
49.description: However, the stone is known to emerge amongst hidden treasures─we just need to know where to look. It may behoove us to consult dealers of artifacts from bygone eras.

50.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_710
50.description: Furthermore, each infusion requires the use of a catalyst known as alexandrite. Alexandrite is yielded from treasure coffers whose locations are marked on <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mysterious maps<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

51.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_000_711
51.description: Mysterious maps can be obtained from Auriana at Revenant's Toll in exchange for Allagan tomestones. Completing a certain quest will also earn you a map.

52.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETREPLICA_00171_SYSTEM_100_711
52.description: Alexandrite may also be obtained, albeit at a low probability, by participating in FATEs while equipped with your relic weapon (animus or beyond).
